provenance: heavy marks a weapon that rule 27.3 keeps out of the sewers: the heavy machine gun, the mortar, the one hundred and five millimetre gun, and the anti-tank gun.

Values transcribed from the counter sheet scan described in docs/research/2026-09-07_RV-1_counters_charts.md sections 2 to 4 [S1], and checked against the owner's photographs of the 1977 sheets on 2026-09-17 (docs/research/2026-09-17_RV-10_counter_study.md section 8). The 1977 sheet has five demolition charges. The project writes the values in its own layout and ships no counter art (SR-07).
Squad values are firepower-range-morale (rules 2.2 to 2.4). broken_morale is the number on the reverse side, used for rally and for morale checks of a broken unit (rules 13.6, 14.1).
Machine gun penetration equals the firepower factor: rule 2.8 gives a MMG a penetration factor of 4, and the rule 17.8 example gives the LMG two penetration factors.

Portage points come from the Support Weapons Chart (RV-1 section 7.3). A null pp_leader means one leader cannot carry the weapon (chart note A: two leaders may carry one MMG or HMG one hex per Movement Phase, not modeled in v0.1).
breakdown is the lowest dice roll that malfunctions the weapon (B12 is 12, B11+ is 11).

The flamethrower and the demolition charge come from rules 22 and 23 and from the Support Weapons Chart (RV-1 section 7.3). For the flamethrower the breakdown number is the out of fuel roll of rule 22.6: on 9 or more the weapon leaves the game after the attack. For the charge it is the malfunction roll of rule 23.8.

Vehicle values come from the counter sheet scan described in docs/research/2026-09-07_RV-1_counters_charts.md section 5 [S1]: movement points in the top right, main gun calibre in the bottom left, and the two machine gun factors in the bottom right. gun_he_only is the overscored calibre of rule 28.2 and gun_low_velocity is the asterisk of the same rule. survival is the number on the wreck side, which rule 33.9 uses for the crew. armor_key names the row of rule 33.41 in tables/armor.json. transport_pp is the P number on the counter, and rules 47 and 51 give it its meaning.

FT.note: Rule 22. The breakdown number is the out of fuel roll of rule 22.6, and the weapon leaves the game.

DC.note: Rule 23. The charge is placed in an adjacent hex and explodes in the following Advancing Fire Phase.

PF.note: Rule 37.3. One anti-tank device, removed after use. Rule 37.35 makes it half a machine gun for portage, and a squad may fire four in one player turn.
